Mohammad Saif Urf Jumman vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 3
June, 2025

Author: Siddharth
Bench: Siddharth
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:94530
Reserved On:28.05.2025
Delivered On:03.06.2025
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 42622 of 2024
Applicant :- Mohammad Saif Urf Jumman

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Pramod Kumar Maurya,Sajjad Khan

Counsel for Opposite Party :- Chandra Prakash Kushwaha,G.A.,Sheetal
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
1.

Learned Aga informs that notice has been served on the informant, but no one has turned up to
oppose the bail application.

2. Heard Sri Pramod Kumar Maurya, learned counsel for applicant; learned Aga for State and
perused the material on record.

3. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant,Mohammad Saif Urf
Jumman, with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 100 of 2024, under Section- 363,
366, 342, 376(3), 376(2)(n) of I.P.C., and section 5/6 of Pocso Act and 3(2)(5) of Sc/St Act, Police
Mohammad Saif Urf Jumman vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 3 June, 2025
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172344000/
1

Station - Karari, District- Kaushambi.
4.

entities.text: Mohammad Saif Urf Jumman vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
There is allegation against the applicant of abduction of a minor girl with intent to marry,
commission of offence of repeated rape and offnece under provisions of Pocso Act and Sc/St Act.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in
this case.
6.
Learned AGA has submitted that victim is minor and also belongs to SC/ST.
In her statement recorded before the police and the court, she has admitted that the applicant committed the offence of rape against her.
She was found to be aged about 14 years, 8 months and 24 days at the time of incident.
7. This Court after hearing the learned counsels for the parties does not finds any ground for enlarging the applicant on bail at this stage.
8. The bail application is accordingly, rejected.

9. The trial court is directed to conclude the trial against the applicant as expeditiously as possible,
as per section 309 Cr.P.C. (new section 346 B.N.S.S.)
10. Registrar(Compliance) is directed to communicate this order to the concerned court below within ten days.
